label: Production readiness honesty
query: What should AbarVa say if asked whether all Lakeshore modules are 100% production-ready today?
answer:
My read: AbarVa should answer clearly that for Lakeshore Holdings, the Intelligence surface and private-plane stack are in a pilot/early-production posture — valuable and grounded, but not yet “100% production-ready” across all modules. Why: The live Intelligence surface for Lakeshore is active and using native Azure AI Search for tenant-scoped grounding, with 1,329 data inventory records loaded — so there is real, working capability and live tenant context. Azure private-plane health is explicitly “pilot-substrate healthy with remaining cutover watches,” which means it is not fully cut over or hardened as a complete production estate. Setup/admin approval-ledger proof is not complete, and at least one Source event is only partially through its artifact spine (e.g., LSH-AMS-MODERNIZATION-2026 only safe through Evaluation), which is incompatible with a blanket “100% production-ready across all modules” claim.

Decision fork: If the question is about whether Lakeshore can safely use AbarVa today: “Yes — for defined pilot and advisory use cases on the Intelligence surface, with known guardrails.” If the question is about enterprise-wide, no-exceptions production readiness: “Not yet — several control, approval-ledger, and private-plane cutover steps are still in progress.
